meta.description: Synthetic (invented) CLP classification tests. NOT taken from any ICSI question paper.

expected_outcome_values.CLEAN: One defensible primary node; no rule needed beyond the taxonomy itself
expected_outcome_values.CLEAN_WITH_RULE: One defensible primary node, relying on a documented decision rule (DD-xx / v0.2 decision)
expected_outcome_values.REVIEW: Classifiable, but methodology requires human review (control node, deleted content in a current attempt, or MEDIUM placement confidence)

negative_controls.description: Classifying to an alias node must be rejected
Classifying to a deprecated node must be rejected
Classifying to a structural chapter node must be rejected (records go to topic/subtopic)
The holding node must never count in analytics
